dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Linear, symmetric 2D narrowing of the dorsal profile from the maximum width at the mid-section toward a narrow posterior termination.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Generally smooth lateral margins with a minor asymmetrical concave deviation on the mid-left side where the body mass meets the water line.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with high median pixel intensity; includes a low-intensity blue-grey shadow gradient along the left lateral aspect.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Sharp, high-contrast gradient between the depigmented white dorsal surface and the low-reflectance dark water background.

other_distinctive_markers: Centrally located, high-contrast dark circular aperture representing the blowhole at the anterior dorsal midline.
